sloka: इति इव तम् शोक विधेय देहम्रामम् विसंज्ञम् विलपंतम् एव ।उवाच सौमित्रिःअदीन सत्त्वःन्याये स्थितः काल युतम् च वाक्यम् ॥३-६३-१८॥
transliteration: iti iva tam śoka vidheya dehamrāmam visaṁjñam vilapaṁtam eva ।uvāca saumitriḥadīna sattvaḥnyāye sthitaḥ kāla yutam ca vākyam ॥3-63-18॥

translations.english: While Rama was thus in tears, in a state of sorrow and swoon, Lakshmana who was rational and courageous spoke to him words appropriate to the time :
